reference.speaker: Speaker
reference.text: Okay Tom, let's do the sprint planning. We have two weeks, and the checkout redesign is still open.

reference.speaker: Speaker
reference.text: Right. The payment form is done, but the mobile layout still breaks on small screens.

reference.speaker: Speaker
reference.text: Then I think we should ship the redesign behind a feature flag, and turn it on for ten percent of users first.

reference.speaker: Speaker
reference.text: Agreed. Feature flag, ten percent rollout. That gives us time to watch the error rate.

reference.speaker: Speaker
reference.text: Good. What about the flaky end to end tests? They failed three times this week.

reference.speaker: Speaker
reference.text: I'd say we freeze new features until the test suite is green.

reference.speaker: Speaker
reference.text: Fine, we freeze new features until the tests pass. So, tasks. Tom, can you fix the mobile layout by Wednesday?

reference.speaker: Speaker
reference.text: Yes, I will fix the mobile layout by Wednesday.

reference.speaker: Speaker
reference.text: And I'll set up the feature flag and the error rate dashboard.

reference.speaker: Speaker
reference.text: Priya should own the flaky tests. Maya, can you ask her to fix them this week?

reference.speaker: Speaker
reference.text: Sure. I'll ask Priya to fix the end to end tests by Friday. That's it, thanks Tom.
